evidence.why: Two sibling lanes implemented planSendReactions independently on top of 6eeb4fc, which carried no such function. build/f2-push-fresh landed 323445d and bb58e00; build/f2-push-notify-infra landed 7f4531e. This was an add/add collision, so one had to be chosen rather than both taken.
evidence.oracle_does_not_discriminate: steps/push-server.steps.ts came from the merge base and is byte-identical on both lanes. It reads only `deletions`, and both implementations pass all five R20/R21 scenarios. 01-13's and 01-14's roadmap criteria also fail to discriminate. So the choice was decided by running each lane's unit properties against the other lane's implementation.
evidence.decisive_red: notify-infra's properties FAIL against fresh's implementation on two real behaviours, both semantic AssertionErrors. (1) 'a gone answer for a destination this run never sent to is evidence about nothing' - fresh ignores its own declared `sends` input (its comment states 'the rule does not read this') and prunes on any gone-status response, so a mismatched or replayed 410 deletes a LIVE subscription. (2) 'every pruned destination leaves a loud witness naming it' - fresh returns events: [] unconditionally. The reverse does not hold: fresh's pruning properties pass against notify-infra's implementation, which is a strict superset of observable behaviour.
evidence.pruneevent_overrule: The named push_subscription_pruned witness is a DELIVER overrule, taken under this step's own invitation ('NAMED BY NO DOCUMENT ... if DELIVER prefers a different name or a different module, say so in the step evidence'). 07-write-path.md section 8.4 attaches LOUD to the run-cap skip only: 'per-run send cap 10,000 with a LOUD skip event past it; 404/410/403 responses prune the item on first send'. No document requires a witness on prune. Kept because it makes `events` mean something on the same module whose planNotifications already announces notification_run_cap_reached, and because a subscription deleted with no witness is a subscriber lost with nobody to notice.
evidence.gone_set_unchanged: 404, 410, 403 exactly, per section 8.4 and adr-push-vapid-direct.md decision 4. The oracle writes the set from the specification and never imports the production constant, so an implementation that widened it cannot make its own oracle agree with it.
evidence.no_test_lost: notify-infra never carried step 01-12's run-cap property (f1b43bb, the fresh lane's own commit). Taking its test file wholesale would have silently deleted a passing test. The merged file carries fresh's run-cap property PLUS notify-infra's two planSendReactions properties. Verified present, verified falsifiable: dropping the loud cap event fails the run-cap property and its scenario alone.
